summary: 1.0.61: squelch_new.vhf.sql9 = 124 is outside uv5r.py's 0-123, CHIRP leaves it unset and set_settings raises int(None), so no setting can be written. Radio is labelled UV-5RH Pro GPS but reads 45 channels with the UV-5R profile.
title: Settings write fails on out-of-range factory squelch calibration
